units.source_text: 且说夕雾大将那天昼间从六条院回三条院自邸。

en.t: Now, General Yugiri returned that afternoon from Rokujo-in to his own residence at Sanjo-in.

units.source_text: 今宵倘再访小野山庄，则外人将以为昨夜真有其事，而事实上还不配如此，因此只得努力忍住。

en.t: If he visited the villa at Ono again that night, people would think something really had happened the night before; since matters had not in fact gone that far, he could only force himself to hold back.

units.source_text: 然而恋慕之苦，反而比往日增加了千倍。

en.t: Yet the torment of longing only grew a thousand times stronger than before.

units.source_text: 夫人云居雁隐约闻知丈夫有偷情之事，脸上装作不知，只管躺在自己的起居室中，和孩子们玩耍消遣。

en.t: His wife, Kumoinokari, had vaguely heard that her husband was having an affair, but she pretended not to know and simply lay in her own sitting room, passing the time by playing with the children.

units.source_text: 黄昏初过，小野山庄送回信来了。

en.t: Just after dusk, a reply arrived from the villa at Ono.

units.source_text: 夕雾拆开一看，此信与往常不同，文字都像鸟迹。

en.t: When Yugiri opened it and looked, he saw that the letter was unlike the usual ones, and the writing looked like bird tracks.

units.source_text: 一时不能辨识，便把灯火移近，仔细阅读。

en.t: Unable to make it out at first, he brought the lamp closer and read it carefully.

units.source_text: 云居雁虽然住在隔壁室中，却早就看到有信送来，便悄悄地走到夕雾背后，把那信抢了去。

en.t: Although Kumoinokari was in the next room, she had already seen the letter arrive, so she quietly came up behind Yugiri and snatched it away.

units.source_text: 夕雾吓了一跳，对她说道：“这算什么呢？

en.t: Yugiri was startled and said to her, "What is the meaning of this?

units.source_text: 真正岂有此理！

en.t: This is truly outrageous!

units.source_text: 这是六条院东院那位继母送给我的信呀。

en.t: This is a letter sent to me by my stepmother in the eastern wing of Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 她今天早上受了风寒。

en.t: She caught a chill this morning.

units.source_text: 我告辞父亲出门时，不曾再去望她，心甚挂念。

en.t: When I took leave of my father and went out, I did not go to see her again, and I was very worried about her.

units.source_text: 回家后送信去探问病状，这是她的回信呀！

en.t: After I came home, I sent a letter asking about her condition, and this is her reply!

units.source_text: 你看吧，情书难道写得这样的？

en.t: Look at it yourself. Would a love letter ever be written like this?

units.source_text: 况且你这种态度多么野蛮啊！

en.t: Besides, how barbarous this behavior of yours is!

units.source_text: 相处年月越久，越是看人不起，真正气死我也！

en.t: The longer we live together, the more contempt you show for me; it truly infuriates me!

units.source_text: 你不管我怎样想，全不怕难为情。”

en.t: You do not care what I think, and you feel no shame at all."

units.source_text: 他愤然地叹一口气，并不表示可惜的样子要去夺回信来。

en.t: He sighed angrily, but he did not show any anxious regret or try to snatch the letter back.

units.source_text: 云居雁也不立刻看信，只是拿在手里，答道：“你说‘相处年月越久，越是看人不起’，你对我才如此呢！”

en.t: Kumoinokari did not read the letter at once either, but held it in her hand and replied, "You say that the longer people live together, the more they look down on each other, but that is exactly how you treat me!"

units.source_text: 她看见夕雾泰然自若，不免有些忌惮，只是撒娇撒痴地说了这一句话。

en.t: Seeing Yugiri so calm and composed, she could not help feeling a little intimidated, and said only this one line in a spoiled, petulant way.

units.source_text: 夕雾笑道：“谁对谁都好，这原是人世常态。

en.t: Yugiri laughed and said, "It is simply the way of the world for people to show favor to one another.

units.source_text: 不过像我这样的人，别处怕找不到。

en.t: But I doubt you would find anyone like me elsewhere.

units.source_text: 一个身份高贵的人，斜目也不看一眼，守定一个妻子，好像惧怕雌鹰的雄鹰一样，多么惹人耻笑！

en.t: For a man of high rank to refuse even a sideways glance and cling to just one wife, like a male hawk afraid of the female, is something people would laugh at.

units.source_text: 被这样顽固的丈夫死守着，在你也不是光荣的。

en.t: It is no honor for you either to be guarded so stubbornly by such a husband.

units.source_text: 须得在许多妇人之中，特别受丈夫爱怜，地位与众不同，这才可教别人艳羡，自己心里也常愉快，于是欢乐之情、可爱之事，源源不绝而来。

en.t: Only when, among many women, you are especially loved by your husband and hold a position unlike the others can you make people envy you and keep your own heart happy, so that joy and charming pleasures come without end.

units.source_text: 如今教我像某翁那样专心一意地死守一个少女，真乃可惜之事。

en.t: To make me now cling single-mindedly to one young woman like some old man would truly be a waste.

units.source_text: 这在你有什么体面呢？”

en.t: What dignity would there be in that for you?"

units.source_text: 他花言巧语地想骗出那封信来。

en.t: With smooth words, he tried to coax the letter out of her.

units.source_text: 云居雁嫣然一笑，说道：“你想装成体面，教我这老婆子苦死！

en.t: Kumoinokari smiled sweetly and said, "You try to put on a respectable face and make this old wife of yours suffer terribly!

units.source_text: 近来你的模样变得浮薄可厌，我向来没有看惯这种模样，心中实在难过得很。

en.t: Lately you have become frivolous and hateful; I have never been used to seeing you like this, and it truly pains me.

units.source_text: 正是‘从来不使侬心苦……’呀！”

en.t: It is just like, 'You never used to make my heart suffer...'"

units.source_text: 娇嗔之相，亦自可爱。

en.t: Even her petulant, coquettish anger was charming in its own way.

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“你的意思是‘今日突然教我忧’吧，究竟为了何事呢？

en.t: Yugiri answered, "You mean, 'Today you suddenly make me grieve,' do you? What exactly is this about?

units.source_text: 你一直不曾说起，也太疏远我了。

en.t: You have never mentioned it until now; that is much too distant of you.

units.source_text: 定然是有不良之人搬弄是非。

en.t: Surely some ill-natured person has been stirring up trouble.

units.source_text: 其人不知怎的一向不赞许我，为了我的绿袍，至今还看我不起，因此把种种难听的话隐隐约约地讲给你听，企图离间我们。

en.t: For some reason that person has never approved of me, and because of my green robe still looks down on me; so they have been hinting all sorts of unpleasant things to you, trying to drive us apart.

units.source_text: 于是为了一个毫无关系的人，你就大吃其醋……”

en.t: And so, over someone who has nothing to do with me, you have become wildly jealous..."

units.source_text: 他口上虽然如此说，但念落叶之事将来终于要成就的，所以并不特别强调。

en.t: Although he said this aloud, he believed that the matter with Ochiba would eventually come to pass, so he did not press the point too strongly.

units.source_text: 大辅乳母听了这话很难为情，一句话也不说。

en.t: When Taifu no Menoto heard these words, she felt very embarrassed and said nothing at all.

units.source_text: 两人谈东说西，云居雁还是把信藏过，夕雾也不强要取回，没精打采地就寝了。

en.t: The two talked of this and that, but Kumoinokari still kept the letter hidden, and Yugiri, not insisting on taking it back, went to bed dejected.

units.source_text: 但他胸中忐忑不安，总想设法取它回来。

en.t: Yet his heart was restless, and he kept thinking of some way to get it back.

units.source_text: 料想这是老夫人写的信，不知信中说些什么。

en.t: He supposed it was a letter written by the old lady, and he did not know what it might say.

units.source_text: 他躺着寻思，不能成寐。

en.t: He lay there thinking and could not fall asleep.

units.source_text: 云居雁已经睡着，他装作若无其事地向她的茵褥底下探索，然而没有找到。

en.t: After Kumoinokari had fallen asleep, he pretended nothing was amiss and searched under her bedding, but he did not find it.

units.source_text: 不知道那封信藏在何处，心中十分懊恼。

en.t: Not knowing where the letter had been hidden, he felt deeply vexed.
